papers.title: Effect of Laser Power on the Corrosion and Wear Resistance of Laser Cladding TC4 Alloy
papers.abstract: TC4 alloy coatings were fabricated on a titanium alloy substrate using laser cladding. The influence of laser power ranging from 1000 W to 2200 W on the microhardness, wear resistance, and electrochemical corrosion behavior in 3.5% NaCl solution was systematically investigated. Results demonstrate that the TC4 coating exhibited a 35.17% enhancement in microhardness compared to the substrate, with an average value reaching 500 HV. As the laser power increased from 1000 W to 2200 W, the maximum wear depth progressively decreased, indicating significantly improved wear resistance, with fatigue wear being identified as the dominant mechanism. The coating prepared at 1400 W showed the best corrosion performance, displaying the highest self-corrosion potential of −0.110 V, the lowest corrosion current density of 0.125 μA·cm−2, and the largest polarization resistance of 2.057 × 106 Ω·cm2. The charge transfer resistance initially increased and then decreased with increasing laser power. Numerical simulations revealed that when exposed to seawater, galvanic couples formed between the α and β phases on the TC4 titanium alloy surface, resulting in preferential dissolution of the β-phase.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究激光熔覆TC4涂层的腐蚀和耐磨性，而非机械或疲劳性能，与方向L1（Ti-6Al-4V基础力学与疲劳）相关性较弱。
llm.why_not_core: No mechanical/fatigue characterization (tensile, fatigue life, S-N curves); focuses on corrosion and wear resistance.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究激光功率对激光熔覆TC4涂层腐蚀和耐磨性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 不同功率激光熔覆制备TC4涂层，进行显微硬度、磨损和电化学腐蚀测试及数值模拟。
summary_zh.result: 涂层显微硬度提高35.17%，1400W时腐蚀性能最佳，磨损深度随功率增加而减小。
summary_zh.validation: 通过显微硬度仪、磨损试验机和电化学工作站进行实验验证，并辅以数值模拟。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of laser power on the corrosion and wear resistance of laser-clad TC4 coatings on a titanium alloy substrate.
summary_en.method: TC4 coatings were fabricated by laser cladding at powers from 1000 W to 2200 W, and microhardness, wear resistance, and electrochemical corrosion in 3.5% NaCl solution were characterized.
summary_en.result: The coating exhibited 35.17% higher microhardness than the substrate; wear resistance improved with increasing laser power, and the best corrosion performance was achieved at 1400 W.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation via microhardness testing, wear depth measurement, and electrochemical impedance spectroscopy, supplemented by numerical simulation of galvanic coupling.

papers.title: Tailoring microstructure and tribological performance of directed energy deposited Ti-6Al-4V alloy through in-situ oxygen doping

corresponding_authors.name: Sihan Yu

corresponding_authors.affiliation: Faculty of Civil Engineering Technology, Universiti Malaysia Pahang Al-Sultan Abdullah, Kuantan 26300, Malaysia

llm.relevance_to_user: 该研究涉及增材制造Ti-6Al-4V的微观结构和摩擦学性能，但未涉及力学或疲劳性能，与方向核心关注点关联较弱。
llm.why_not_core: No tensile, fatigue, or mechanical strength data; focuses on tribological performance rather than mechanical/fatigue characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 通过原位氧掺杂改善DED Ti-6Al-4V的耐磨性。
summary_zh.method: 在DED过程中原位掺氧，调控微观组织。
summary_zh.result: 氧掺杂细化了α板条并产生固溶强化，提高了硬度和耐磨性。
summary_zh.validation: 摩擦磨损试验与微观组织表征。

summary_en.motivation: To enhance the tribological performance of DED Ti-6Al-4V by tailoring its microstructure through in-situ oxygen doping.
summary_en.method: In-situ oxygen doping was applied during directed energy deposition to modify the α-lath morphology and oxygen content.
summary_en.result: Oxygen doping refined the α-lath structure and induced solid solution strengthening, leading to improved hardness and wear resistance.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation through wear testing and microstructural analysis.
